lines.en: Excuse me, is this the bus to the station?
lines.tr: Affedersiniz, bu otobüs istasyona mı gidiyor?

lines.en: No, this is number nine. You need number twelve.
lines.tr: Hayır, bu dokuz numara. Size on iki lazım.

lines.en: When does it come?
Every twenty minutes. The next one is at ten past four.
lines.tr: Yirmi dakikada bir. Sonraki dördü on geçe.

lines.en: Thank you. Is it far to the station?
Ten minutes by bus. You can walk in half an hour.
lines.tr: Otobüsle on dakika. Yürüyerek yarım saatte gidersiniz.

lines.en: I have a big bag, so I will wait.
lines.tr: Büyük bir çantam var, o yüzden bekleyeceğim.

lines.en: Good idea. Here it comes now.

questions.q: Which bus does Mert need?
When is the next bus?
questions.note: "The next one is at ten past four."

questions.q: How long does the bus take?
Why does Mert wait?
questions.note: "I have a big bag, so I will wait."

questions.q: What happens at the end?

lines.en: Hello. I want to take this book, please.
lines.tr: Merhaba. Bu kitabı almak istiyorum lütfen.

lines.en: Do you have a card?
Yes, here it is.
Thank you. You can keep it for two weeks.
Can I take two books?
Yes, but not three. Three is for teachers.
lines.tr: Evet ama üç olmaz. Üç, öğretmenler için.

lines.en: Two is enough. What day must I come back?
The twentieth. It is on this paper.

questions.q: What does the librarian ask for first?
How long can Ceyda keep the book?
questions.note: "You can keep it for two weeks."

questions.q: How many books can she take?
Who can take three books?
When must she come back?

lines.en: Hi. Is this seat free?
Yes, sit down. I am Lara.
I am Berk. Are you new here too?
lines.tr: Ben Berk. Sen de yeni misin?

lines.en: Yes. I came from Izmir last month.
Do you like the school?
The teachers are nice but the building is very cold.
lines.tr: Öğretmenler iyi ama bina çok soğuk.

lines.en: In winter it is always cold. Bring a big coat.
lines.tr: Kışın hep soğuk olur. Kalın bir ceket getir.

lines.en: Thank you. What lesson do we have now?
English. It is my favorite.

questions.q: Where did Lara come from?
When did she come?
What is the problem with the building?
What does Berk say she should bring?
What lesson do they have now?

lines.en: Good afternoon. How much is the chocolate cake?
lines.tr: İyi günler. Çikolatalı kek ne kadar?

lines.en: Sixty for a small one, ninety for a big one.
We are six people at home.
Then take the big one. The small one is for three.
lines.tr: O zaman büyüğü alın. Küçüğü üç kişilik.

lines.en: All right, the big one. Do you have apple cake too?
lines.tr: Tamam, büyüğü. Elmalı kek de var mı?

lines.en: Not today. Come on Friday.
My mother loves apple cake.
Then I will keep one for her.
lines.tr: O hâlde ona bir tane ayırırım.

questions.q: How much is the big cake?
Why does Melek take the big one?
Is there apple cake today?
When can she come for apple cake?
What does the seller offer to do?
questions.note: "Then I will keep one for her."

lines.en: Sevil, I am at the door and I do not have my key.
Again? Where is it?
I think it is on my desk at work.
I am at my mother's house. I can come at seven.
It is five now. Two hours is a long time.
lines.tr: Şimdi saat beş. İki saat uzun.

lines.en: Go to the cafe on the corner and have a tea.
lines.tr: Köşedeki kafeye git ve bir çay iç.

lines.en: Good idea. I have my book with me.
And tomorrow we will make a second key.
lines.tr: Yarın da ikinci bir anahtar yaptıracağız.

questions.q: What is Umut's problem?
options: He does not have his key

questions.q: Where does he think the key is?
questions.note: "I think it is on my desk at work."

questions.q: What time can Sevil come?
What does Sevil tell him to do?
questions.note: "Go to the cafe on the corner."

questions.q: What will they do tomorrow?
questions.note: "Tomorrow we will make a second key."
